letter.label: Founder's letter
letter.title: A private office, a single point of contact
paragraphs: I have spent my whole working life looking after houses that are not mine, and after people who trust that everything will be in its place.
I created JR to offer in Andorra what I always missed: a discreet office that answers, anticipates and never needs reminding.
I do not work with catalogues or anonymous processes: I know every house, every key and every preference.
My commitment is simple: that you arrive and relax, and that nothing is left unattended while you are away.
letter.portraitAlt: Sober portrait of Jaume Roca, founder of JR Hospitality, in a warmly lit interior

andorra.label: Andorra
andorra.title: Why here and why now
andorra.text: Andorra brings together the mountains, quiet and an international community that spends ever longer seasons here. Houses are used by the week, not by the month, and need someone to keep them alive between stays. We live and work here: we know the valleys, the trades and the trusted people it takes to keep everything running.
